Method of Attack: Installs a root CA certificate into the Windows trusted root certificate store without removal, potentially allowing misuse if private key is compromised
Root certificate installation to support driver signing on Windows XP machines
Impacted Systems: Windows systems with Savitech USB audio driver installed
Attack Vector: Driver installation package that installs root CA certificates
Bundled inside setup software for various hardware vendors' products
